First note the relation between \(x\) and \(y\):
\[
y=t^2-3t+2 \implies t^2-3t=y-2.
\]
Then
\[
x=3t^2-9t-5=3(t^2-3t)-5=3(y-2)-5=3y-11.
\]
So the ball moves along the line
\[
x=3y-11.
\]

The \(y\)-coordinate is
\[
y=t^2-3t+2=\left(t-\frac32\right)^2-\frac14.
\]
For \(0\le t\le 4\), the minimum is
\[
y_{\min}=-\frac14
\]

\[
y(0)=2,\qquad y(4)=6,
\]
we have
\[
y_{\max}=6.
\]
